prompt: Record a fixture-local compensable action receipt and require targeted recovery to produce an explicit compensation record without claiming rollback.

initial_state.task_intent: Treat a compensable action as requiring compensation rather than strict rollback.

input_artifacts.description: Local note describing the compensable fixture action.

success_criteria: The runtime does not claim strict rollback for the compensable action.
The Episode Journal records rollback_status compensation_required.
Targeted Recovery writes an explicit compensation record.
failure_criteria: The compensable action is committed as if it were reversible.
